examples.translation: The letter was written yesterday.

entries.intro: Past tense singular masculine form of the verb 'देना' (#36) meaning 'gave'. Also used as a compound verb helper indicating action directed outward.
entries.usage: Past form of देना (देता, दिया, देगा). Pronounced 'diyaa'.

examples.sentence: उसने मुझे एक उपहार दिया।
examples.translation: He gave me a gift.

examples.sentence: उसने काम पूरा कर दिया।
examples.translation: He completed the work. (Compound verb: कर + दिया)

examples.sentence: यदि उसने मुझे पैसे दिए होते, तो मैं जाता।
examples.translation: If he had given me money, I would go.

examples.sentence: गरीबों को भोजन दिया गया।
examples.translation: Food was given to the poor.

entries.intro: Past tense singular masculine form of 'लेना' (#37) meaning 'took'. As a compound verb helper, indicates action done for oneself.
entries.usage: Past form of लेना (लेता, लिया, लेगा). Pronounced 'liyaa'.

examples.sentence: उसने बाज़ार से फल लिया।
examples.translation: He took/bought fruit from the market.

examples.sentence: मैंने अपना गृहकार्य कर लिया।
examples.translation: I did my homework. (Compound verb: कर + लिया)

examples.sentence: यदि तुमने समय पर खाना खा लिया होता, तो अच्छा होता।
examples.translation: If you had eaten food on time, it would be good.

examples.sentence: यह निर्णय सर्वसम्मति से लिया गया।
examples.translation: This decision was taken unanimously.

entries.intro: Past tense singular masculine form of 'कहना' (#38) meaning 'said'.
entries.usage: Past form of कहना. Pronounced 'kahaa'. Requires 'ने' marker with agent.

examples.sentence: राम ने मुझसे कहा कि वह आएगा।
examples.translation: Ram said to me that he will come.

examples.sentence: उसने सच कहा था।
examples.translation: He had said the truth.

examples.sentence: यदि उसने यह कहा होता, तो विवाद होता।
examples.translation: If he had said this, there would be a dispute.

examples.sentence: ऐसा हमेशा कहा जाता है।
examples.translation: It is always said so.

entries.intro: The infinitive verb meaning 'to go'. Also serves as auxiliary verb to construct the passive voice.
entries.usage: Root conjugation: जाना, गया, जाएगा. Forms passive when added after the perfective participle of another verb.

examples.sentence: मुझे स्कूल जाना है।
examples.translation: I have to go to school.

examples.sentence: वह हर रविवार मंदिर जाता है।
examples.translation: He goes to the temple every Sunday.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं वहाँ जाता, तो वह मिलता।
examples.translation: If I went there, he would meet.

examples.sentence: यह काम राम द्वारा किया जाना है।
examples.translation: This work is to be done by Ram.

entries.intro: The infinitive verb meaning 'to come'. Opposite of 'जाना' (#34).
entries.usage: Root conjugation: आना, आया, आएगा. In compound verbs, shows progress toward the present.

examples.sentence: तुम्हें मेरे घर आना होगा।
examples.translation: You will have to come to my house.

examples.sentence: मेहमान आज आ रहे हैं।
examples.translation: Guests are coming today.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम आते, तो हम फिल्म देखते।
examples.translation: If you came, we would watch a movie.

examples.sentence: यहाँ हर साल लाखों पर्यटक आते हैं।
examples.translation: Millions of tourists come here every year. (Intransitive, used in passive context: पर्यटकों का स्वागत किया जाता है)

entries.intro: The infinitive verb meaning 'to give'. Cross-referenced with 'लेना' (#37).
entries.usage: Conjugation: देना, दिया, देगा. In compound verbs, indicates action directed outwards.

examples.sentence: मुझे एक गिलास पानी देना।
examples.translation: Give me a glass of water.

examples.sentence: वह गरीबों को पैसे देता है।
examples.translation: He gives money to the poor.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम मुझे किताब देते, तो मैं पढ़ता।
examples.translation: If you gave me the book, I would read.

examples.sentence: छात्रों को पुरस्कार दिए गए।
examples.translation: Awards were given to the students.

entries.intro: The infinitive verb meaning 'to take'. Cross-referenced with 'देना' (#36).
entries.usage: Conjugation: लेना, लिया, लेगा. In compound verbs, indicates action directed inwards.

examples.sentence: दुकानदार से रसीद लेना मत भूलना।
examples.translation: Don't forget to take the receipt from the shopkeeper.

examples.sentence: वह हर काम सोच-समझकर लेता है।
examples.translation: He takes every task thoughtfully.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं तुम्हारी सलाह लेता, तो नुकसान न होता।
examples.translation: If I took your advice, there would be no loss.

examples.sentence: यह सामान बाज़ार से लिया गया है।
examples.translation: This item has been taken from the market.

entries.intro: The infinitive verb meaning 'to say' or 'to tell'.
entries.usage: Transitive. Requires ergative particle 'ने' in past tenses.

examples.sentence: मुझे तुमसे कुछ कहना है।
examples.translation: I have to say something to you.

examples.sentence: वह हमेशा सच कहता है।
examples.translation: He always says the truth.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं तुमसे कहता, तो क्या तुम सुनते?
examples.translation: If I told you, would you listen?

examples.sentence: ऐसा पुराने लोगों द्वारा कहा जाता था।
examples.translation: This was said by old people.

entries.intro: Conjugated form of the modal verb 'सकना' (to be able to, added as companion). Expresses ability or permission.
entries.usage: Always follows the root form of the main verb (e.g. कर सकता है - can do).

examples.sentence: वह बहुत तेज़ दौड़ सकता है।
examples.translation: He can run very fast.

examples.sentence: क्या मैं अंदर आ सकता हूँ?
examples.translation: Can I come in?

examples.sentence: यदि मैं अंग्रेजी बोल पाता, तो विदेश जा सकता।
examples.translation: If I could speak English, I could go abroad.

examples.sentence: यह काम राम द्वारा आसानी से किया जा सकता है।
examples.translation: This work can easily be done by Ram.

entries.intro: An auxiliary/defective verb expressing necessity, obligation (should), or desire (want). Companion: 'चाहना' (to want, added as companion).
entries.usage: Invariable form. Used with a dative subject (marked by 'को') and either a noun (wants) or infinitive verb (should).

examples.sentence: मुझे एक नई किताब चाहिए।
examples.translation: I want a new book.

examples.sentence: तुम्हें रोज़ पढ़ाई करनी चाहिए।
examples.translation: You should study every day.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम्हें मदद चाहिए होती, तो तुम कहते।
examples.translation: If you wanted help, you would say so.

examples.sentence: सभी नियमों का पालन किया जाना चाहिए।
examples.translation: All rules should be followed.

entries.intro: Indefinite pronoun or adjective referring to everything or everyone in a group.
entries.usage: Invariable. Often paired with 'कुछ' (सब कुछ - everything) or 'लोग' (सब लोग - everyone).

examples.sentence: सब लोग घर चले गए।
examples.translation: All people went home.

examples.sentence: सब कुछ ठीक है।
examples.translation: Everything is fine.

examples.sentence: यदि सब शांत होते, तो मैं बोलता।
examples.translation: If everyone were quiet, I would speak.

examples.sentence: यह ज्ञान सब में बाँटा जाता है।
examples.translation: This knowledge is shared among all.

entries.intro: Indefinite pronoun referring to an unspecified person or object. Cross-referenced with 'कुछ' (#43).
entries.usage: Oblique form is 'किसी'. Used as adjective before countable nouns.

examples.sentence: वहाँ कोई खड़ा है।
examples.translation: Someone is standing there.

examples.sentence: क्या आपके पास कोई योजना है?
examples.translation: Do you have any plan?

examples.sentence: यदि कोई हमारी मदद करता, तो हम जीत जाते।
examples.translation: If someone helped us, we would win.

examples.sentence: यह काम किसी के द्वारा किया जाना चाहिए।
examples.translation: This work should be done by someone.

entries.intro: Indefinite pronoun or adjective referring to unspecified objects, quantity, or degree. Cross-referenced with 'कोई' (#42).
entries.usage: Used for uncountable nouns or abstract ideas. Oblique form remains 'कुछ'.

examples.sentence: मेज पर कुछ रखा है।
examples.translation: Something is placed on the table.

examples.sentence: मुझे कुछ पानी चाहिए।
examples.translation: I want some water.

examples.sentence: यदि कुछ पैसे होते, तो मैं घूमता।
examples.translation: If there were some money, I would travel.

examples.sentence: इस बारे में कुछ किया जाना चाहिए।
examples.translation: Something should be done about this.

entries.intro: Indicates a large quantity or high degree. Equivalent to 'very', 'many', or 'a lot'.
entries.usage: Invariable. Can modify adjectives, adverbs, or nouns.

examples.sentence: यह कमरा बहुत बड़ा है।
examples.translation: This room is very big.

examples.sentence: वहाँ बहुत लोग थे।
examples.translation: There were many people there.

examples.sentence: यदि मेरे पास बहुत समय होता, तो मैं आता।
examples.translation: If I had a lot of time, I would come.

examples.sentence: यह पुस्तक बहुत पसंद की जाती है।
examples.translation: This book is liked a lot.

entries.intro: A masculine plural noun referring to human beings collectively.
entries.usage: Always plural. Acts as a plural suffix for pronouns (e.g. 'हम लोग' - we people). Oblique is 'लोगों'.

examples.sentence: लोग क्या सोचेंगे?
examples.translation: What will people think?

examples.sentence: यहाँ बहुत से लोग रहते हैं।
examples.translation: Many people live here.

examples.sentence: यदि लोग मेरी बात सुनते, तो अच्छा होता।
examples.translation: If people listened to me, it would be good.

examples.sentence: लोगों को सूचित किया जाता है।
examples.translation: People are being informed.

entries.intro: Work, duty, task, or business. Can also mean lust/passion.
entries.usage: derivation: 'काम करना' (to work). Plural is also 'काम'. Oblique is 'काम'.

examples.sentence: मैं अपना काम कर रहा हूँ।
examples.translation: I am doing my work.

examples.sentence: वह दफ़्तर में काम करता है।
examples.translation: He works in the office.

examples.sentence: यदि मुझे काम मिल जाता, तो मैं खुश होता।
examples.translation: If I got a job, I would be happy.

examples.sentence: यह काम राम द्वारा पूरा किया गया।
examples.translation: This work was completed by Ram.

entries.intro: Time, duration, or era.
entries.usage: masculine noun. 'समय पर' (on time), 'समय बिताना' (to spend time).

examples.sentence: मेरे पास समय नहीं है।
examples.translation: I do not have time.

examples.sentence: समय बहुत कीमती है।
examples.translation: Time is very precious.

examples.sentence: यदि हमारे पास समय होता, तो हम फिल्म देखते।
examples.translation: If we had time, we would watch a movie.

examples.sentence: समय को नष्ट नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।
examples.translation: Time should not be wasted.

entries.intro: A highly common feminine noun meaning a spoken word, matter, opinion, or topic of discussion.
entries.usage: Plural is 'बातें'. 'बात करना' (to talk).

examples.sentence: यह एक महत्वपूर्ण बात है।
examples.translation: This is an important matter.

examples.sentence: वह मुझसे बात कर रहा था।
examples.translation: He was talking to me.

examples.sentence: यदि वह मेरी बात मान लेता, तो अच्छा होता।
examples.translation: If he had accepted my word, it would be good.

examples.sentence: यह बात सबके सामने उठाई गई।
examples.translation: This matter was raised in front of everyone.

entries.intro: A building for human habitation, or the emotional concept of home.
entries.usage: Plural is 'घर'. Oblique singular is 'घर', oblique plural is 'घरों'.

examples.sentence: यह मेरा नया घर है।
examples.translation: This is my new house.

examples.sentence: मैं शाम को घर जाऊँगा।
examples.translation: I will go home in the evening.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं घर पर होता, तो आराम करता।
examples.translation: If I were at home, I would rest.

examples.sentence: यह घर हाल ही में बेचा गया है।
examples.translation: This house has been sold recently.

entries.intro: A word by which a person, place, or thing is known.
entries.usage: Plural is 'नाम'. Oblique is 'नाम'.

examples.sentence: आपका नाम क्या है?
examples.translation: What is your name?

examples.sentence: मेरा नाम अमित है।
examples.translation: My name is Amit.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं उसका नाम जानता, तो बता देता।
examples.translation: If I knew his name, I would tell.

examples.sentence: उसका नाम सूची में दर्ज किया गया है।
examples.translation: His name has been recorded in the list.

entries.intro: Affectionate or standard name for a mother. Cross-referenced with 'पिता' (#52).
entries.usage: die/feminine. Plural is 'माएँ'.

examples.sentence: मेरी माँ बहुत अच्छा खाना बनाती हैं।
examples.translation: My mother cooks very good food.

examples.sentence: माँ ने मुझे प्यार किया।
examples.translation: Mother loved me.

examples.sentence: यदि मेरी माँ यहाँ होतीं, तो मुझे खुशी होती।
examples.translation: If my mother were here, I would be happy.

examples.sentence: माँ को हर साल सम्मानित किया जाता है।
examples.translation: Mother is honored every year.

entries.intro: A male parent. Cross-referenced with 'माँ' (#51).
entries.usage: masculine noun. Oblique/plural form remains 'पिता' (or 'पिताजी' for respect).

examples.sentence: मेरे पिता एक शिक्षक हैं।
examples.translation: My father is a teacher.

examples.sentence: पिताजी ने मुझे बुलाया।
examples.translation: Father called me.

examples.sentence: यदि मेरे पिता यहाँ होते, तो वे गर्व महसूस करते।
examples.translation: If my father were here, he would feel proud.

examples.sentence: पिताजी को एक नया उपहार दिया गया।
examples.translation: Father was given a new gift.

entries.intro: A person whom one knows and has a bond of mutual affection. Can be used for both males and females.
entries.usage: masculine (though feminine context uses same noun with feminine verbs). Plural: 'दोस्त'.

examples.sentence: वह मेरा सबसे अच्छा दोस्त है।
examples.translation: He is my best friend.

examples.sentence: मेरे बहुत सारे दोस्त हैं।
examples.translation: I have a lot of friends.

examples.sentence: यदि मेरा दोस्त यहाँ होता, तो हम खेलते।
examples.translation: If my friend were here, we would play.

examples.sentence: दोस्त को पार्टी में आमंत्रित किया गया है।
examples.translation: The friend has been invited to the party.

entries.intro: A male child or young man. Cross-referenced with feminine 'लड़की' (#55).
entries.usage: Plural: 'लड़के'. Oblique singular: 'लड़के', oblique plural: 'लड़कों'.

examples.sentence: लड़का मैदान में खेल रहा है।
examples.translation: The boy is playing in the field.

examples.sentence: वह एक अच्छा लड़का है।
examples.translation: He is a good boy.

examples.sentence: यदि वह लड़का समझदार होता, तो यह नहीं करता।
examples.translation: If that boy were smart, he wouldn't do this.

examples.sentence: लड़के को इनाम दिया जाता है।
examples.translation: The boy is given a prize.

entries.intro: A female child or young woman. Cross-referenced with masculine 'लड़का' (#54).
entries.usage: Plural: 'लड़कियाँ'. Oblique singular: 'लड़की', oblique plural: 'लड़कियों'.

examples.sentence: लड़की गाना गा रही है।
examples.translation: The girl is singing a song.

examples.sentence: वह एक होनहार लड़की है।
examples.translation: She is a promising girl.

examples.sentence: यदि वह लड़की यहाँ होती, तो नृत्य करती।
examples.translation: If that girl were here, she would dance.

examples.sentence: लड़की को सम्मानित किया गया।
examples.translation: The girl was honored.

entries.intro: A large human settlement, more populated and developed than a village.
entries.usage: Plural is 'शहर'. Oblique singular: 'शहर', oblique plural: 'शहरों'.

examples.sentence: यह शहर बहुत सुंदर है।
examples.translation: This city is very beautiful.

examples.sentence: वह नौकरी के लिए शहर गया।
examples.translation: He went to the city for a job.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं इस शहर में रहता, तो बहुत घूमता।
examples.translation: If I lived in this city, I would travel a lot.

examples.sentence: यह शहर नदी के किनारे बसाया गया है।
examples.translation: This city is situated on the bank of the river.

entries.intro: A nation state, land, or country.
entries.usage: Plural is 'देश'. Oblique singular: 'देश', oblique plural: 'देशों'.

examples.sentence: हमारा देश भारत है।
examples.translation: Our country is India.

examples.sentence: वह दूसरे देश में काम करता है।
examples.translation: He works in another country.

examples.sentence: यदि हमारा देश समृद्ध होता, तो कोई गरीब न होता।
examples.translation: If our country were prosperous, no one would be poor.

examples.sentence: देश की सीमा की सुरक्षा की जाती है।
examples.translation: The defense of the country's border is maintained.

entries.intro: A period of 365 or 366 days.
entries.usage: Plural is 'साल'. Oblique singular: 'साल', oblique plural: 'सालों'.

examples.sentence: यह साल बहुत अच्छा रहा।
examples.translation: This year was very good.

examples.sentence: वह पाँच साल से यहाँ काम कर रहा है।
examples.translation: He has been working here for five years.

examples.sentence: यदि यह साल आसान होता, तो सब सफल होते।
examples.translation: If this year were easy, everyone would succeed.

examples.sentence: बजट हर साल पेश किया जाता है।
examples.translation: The budget is presented every year.

entries.intro: A period of 24 hours or the daylight period between sunrise and sunset. Cross-referenced with 'रात' (#60).
entries.usage: Plural is 'दिन'. Oblique singular: 'दिन', oblique plural: 'दिनों'.

examples.sentence: आज बहुत धूप वाला दिन है।
examples.translation: Today is a very sunny day.

examples.sentence: मैं दिन में काम करता हूँ।
examples.translation: I work during the day.

examples.sentence: यदि दिन सुहावना होता, तो हम सैर पर जाते।
examples.translation: If the day were pleasant, we would go for a walk.

examples.sentence: यह दिन बहुत हर्षोल्लास से मनाया जाता है।
examples.translation: This day is celebrated with great joy.

entries.intro: The period of darkness between sunset and sunrise. Cross-referenced with 'दिन' (#59).
entries.usage: die/feminine. Plural: 'रातें'. Oblique plural: 'रातों'.

examples.sentence: रात बहुत ठंडी है।
examples.translation: The night is very cold.

examples.sentence: वह रात को सोता है।
examples.translation: He sleeps at night.

examples.sentence: यदि रात चाँदनी होती, तो हम बाहर बैठते।
examples.translation: If the night were moonlit, we would sit outside.

examples.sentence: सड़कें रात को साफ़ की जाती हैं।
examples.translation: The streets are cleaned at night.

entries.intro: The colorless, transparent, odorless liquid that forms the seas, lakes, rivers, and rain.
entries.usage: Uncountable masculine noun. Plural remains 'पानी'.

examples.sentence: मुझे पीने के लिए पानी चाहिए।
examples.translation: I want water to drink.

examples.sentence: नदी में बहुत पानी है।
examples.translation: There is a lot of water in the river.

examples.sentence: यदि पानी साफ़ होता, तो मैं पी लेता।
examples.translation: If the water were clean, I would drink it.

examples.sentence: पौधों को रोज़ पानी दिया जाता है।
examples.translation: Plants are given water every day.

entries.intro: Describes something recently made, introduced, or discovered. Cross-referenced with 'पुराना' (#63).
entries.usage: Inflects for gender/number: नया (masculine singular), नए (masculine plural/oblique), नई (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह मेरा नया फोन है।
examples.translation: This is my new phone.

examples.sentence: हम नए साल का स्वागत कर रहे हैं।
examples.translation: We are welcoming the new year. ('नए' is masculine oblique)

examples.sentence: यदि यह नई योजना होती, तो हम समर्थन करते।
examples.translation: If this were a new plan, we would support it.

examples.sentence: यह नया नियम कल लागू किया जाएगा।
examples.translation: This new rule will be applied tomorrow.

entries.intro: Describes something that has existed for a long time, or is outdated. Cross-referenced with 'नया' (#62).
entries.usage: Inflects: पुराना (masculine), पुराने (masculine oblique/plural), पुरानी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह पुराना घर हमारे दादाजी का है।
examples.translation: This old house belongs to our grandfather.

examples.sentence: वे पुरानी यादें बहुत सुंदर हैं।
examples.translation: Those old memories are very beautiful. ('पुरानी' agrees with feminine plural)

examples.sentence: यदि यह पुराना सिक्का होता, तो बहुत मूल्यवान होता।
examples.translation: If this were an old coin, it would be very valuable.

examples.sentence: पुराने पुल को गिराया जा रहा है।
examples.translation: The old bridge is being demolished.

entries.intro: Describes large physical size, high status, or elder age. Cross-referenced with 'छोटा' (#65).
entries.usage: Inflects: बड़ा (masculine), बड़े (masculine oblique/plural), बड़ी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह एक बड़ा कमरा है।
examples.translation: This is a big room.

examples.sentence: वह मेरा बड़ा भाई है।
examples.translation: He is my elder brother.

examples.sentence: यदि हमारे पास बड़ा घर होता, तो हम आराम से रहते।
examples.translation: If we had a bigger house, we would live comfortably.

examples.sentence: इस शहर में एक बड़ा अस्पताल बनाया जा रहा है।
examples.translation: A large hospital is being built in this city.

entries.intro: Describes small size, low status, or younger age. Cross-referenced with 'बड़ा' (#64).
entries.usage: Inflects: छोटा (masculine), छोटे (masculine oblique/plural), छोटी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह एक छोटा खिलौना है।
examples.translation: This is a small toy.

examples.sentence: वह मेरी छोटी बहन है।
examples.translation: She is my younger sister.

examples.sentence: यदि हमारे पास छोटी गाड़ी होती, तो पार्किंग आसान होती।
examples.translation: If we had a small car, parking would be easy.

examples.sentence: इस छोटे काम को जल्दी पूरा किया जाता है।
examples.translation: This small task is finished quickly.

entries.intro: Refers to high quality, correctness, or acting as an exclamation/response meaning 'okay'. Cross-referenced with 'बुरा' (#67).
entries.usage: Inflects: अच्छा (masculine), अच्छे (masculine oblique/plural), अच्छी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह बहुत अच्छी फिल्म है।
examples.translation: This is a very good movie. ('अच्छी' agrees with feminine 'फिल्म')

examples.sentence: अच्छा, हम कल मिलेंगे।
examples.translation: Okay, we will meet tomorrow. (Exclamation)

examples.sentence: यदि मौसम अच्छा होता, तो हम बाहर जाते।
examples.translation: If the weather were good, we would go outside.

examples.sentence: अच्छे व्यवहार की हमेशा सराहना की जाती है।
examples.translation: Good behavior is always appreciated.

entries.intro: Refers to poor quality, harmful, or morally wrong things. Cross-referenced with 'अच्छा' (#66).
entries.usage: Inflects: बुरा (masculine), बुरे (masculine oblique/plural), बुरी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह एक बुरा सपना था।
examples.translation: This was a bad dream.

examples.sentence: हमें किसी के बारे में बुरा नहीं सोचना चाहिए।
examples.translation: We should not think bad of anyone.

examples.sentence: यदि परिणाम बुरा होता, तो चिंता होती।
examples.translation: If the result were bad, there would be worry.

examples.sentence: बुरे कामों की निंदा की जाती है।
examples.translation: Bad deeds are condemned.

entries.intro: Refers to correctness, health/wellness, or exactness. Very common as a conversational response ('Okay / All right').
entries.usage: Invariable. 'ठीक है' (it is okay / all right), 'ठीक समय पर' (exactly on time).

examples.sentence: वह अब बिल्कुल ठीक है।
examples.translation: He is absolutely fine now.

examples.sentence: यह उत्तर बिल्कुल ठीक है।
examples.translation: This answer is absolutely correct.

examples.sentence: यदि सब कुछ ठीक होता, तो मैं क्यों पूछता?
examples.translation: If everything were fine, why would I ask?

examples.sentence: मशीन को समय पर ठीक किया जाता है।
examples.translation: The machine is repaired on time.

entries.intro: Indicates priority in time, order, or space. Can act as adverb (previously) or compound postposition (before, usually 'से पहले').
entries.usage: Invariable. Often paired with 'से': 'खाने से पहले' (before eating).

examples.sentence: मैं पहले दिल्ली में रहता था।
examples.translation: Previously I lived in Delhi.

examples.sentence: आने से पहले मुझे फोन करना।
examples.translation: Call me before coming.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं पहले आता, तो टिकट मिल जाती।
examples.translation: If I came earlier, I would get the ticket.

examples.sentence: यह काम हमेशा सबसे पहले किया जाता है।
examples.translation: This work is always done first of all.

entries.intro: Refers to the present moment or the immediate situation. Opposite of 'तब' (#78).
entries.usage: Invariable time adverb. Combined with 'ही': 'अभी' (right now).

examples.sentence: अब मुझे घर जाना चाहिए।
examples.translation: Now I should go home.

examples.sentence: अब खेल शुरू हो रहा है।
examples.translation: Now the game is starting.

examples.sentence: यदि वह अब आता, तो हम उसे अंदर आने देते।
examples.translation: If he came now, we would let him in.

examples.sentence: यह नीति अब बदल दी गई है।
examples.translation: This policy has been changed now.

entries.intro: Adverb of place indicating the current location. Cross-referenced with 'वहाँ' (#72) and 'कहाँ' (#76).
entries.usage: Invariable. Fuses with emphatic particle 'ही': 'यहीं' (right here).

examples.sentence: यहाँ बहुत ठंड है।
examples.translation: It is very cold here.

examples.sentence: तुम यहाँ बैठो।
examples.translation: You sit here.

examples.sentence: यदि वह यहाँ होता, तो मेरी मदद करता।
examples.translation: If he were here, he would help me.

examples.sentence: यहाँ हिंदी पढ़ाई जाती है।
examples.translation: Hindi is taught here.

entries.intro: Adverb of place indicating a distant location. Cross-referenced with 'यहाँ' (#71).
entries.usage: Invariable. Fuses with emphatic 'ही': 'वहीं' (right there).

examples.sentence: वहाँ एक बड़ा पेड़ है।
examples.translation: There is a big tree there.

examples.sentence: मैं कल वहाँ जा रहा हूँ।
examples.translation: I am going there tomorrow.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम वहाँ जाते, तो तुम्हें मज़ा आता।
examples.translation: If you went there, you would have fun.

examples.sentence: वहाँ एक नया पुल बनाया जा रहा है।
examples.translation: A new bridge is being built there.

entries.intro: Interrogative pronoun meaning 'what'. Also serves as a sentence-initial particle to introduce yes/no questions.
entries.usage: Oblique form is 'किस'. Placement determines if it means 'what' (inside sentence) or marks a question (at start).

examples.sentence: तुम्हारा नाम क्या है?
examples.translation: What is your name?

examples.sentence: क्या तुम कल आओगे?
examples.translation: Will you come tomorrow? (Yes/No question marker)

examples.sentence: यदि मैं जानता कि समस्या क्या है, तो हल कर देता।
examples.translation: If I knew what the problem is, I would solve it.

examples.sentence: क्या यह काम समय पर किया जा सकता है?
examples.translation: Can this work be done on time?

entries.intro: Interrogative adverb of manner or condition.
entries.usage: Invariable. Often used to ask about wellness ('आप कैसे हैं?' - How are you?).

examples.sentence: आप कैसे हैं?
examples.translation: How are you?

examples.sentence: यह काम कैसे हुआ?
examples.translation: How did this work happen?

examples.sentence: यदि मैं जानता कि वहाँ कैसे जाना है, तो चला जाता।
examples.translation: If I knew how to go there, I would go.

examples.sentence: यह समस्या कैसे हल की जा सकती है?
examples.translation: How can this problem be solved?

entries.intro: Interrogative adverb of reason or cause.
entries.usage: Invariable. Pronounced 'kyon'.

examples.sentence: तुम क्यों रो रहे हो?
examples.translation: Why are you crying?

examples.sentence: वह आज क्यों नहीं आया?
examples.translation: Why didn't he come today?

examples.sentence: यदि मैं कारण जानता कि तुम क्यों उदास हो, तो खुश करता।
examples.translation: If I knew the reason why you are sad, I would make you happy.

examples.sentence: यह नियम क्यों बनाया गया है?
examples.translation: Why was this rule made?

entries.intro: Interrogative adverb of place. Cross-referenced with 'यहाँ' (#71) and 'वहाँ' (#72).
entries.usage: Invariable. Pronounced 'kahaan'. Fuses with 'ही' to mean 'where on earth'.

examples.sentence: तुम्हारा दफ़्तर कहाँ है?
examples.translation: Where is your office?

examples.sentence: तुम कहाँ जा रहे हो?
examples.translation: Where are you going?

examples.sentence: यदि मैं जानता कि तुम कहाँ छिपे हो, तो आ जाता।
examples.translation: If I knew where you are hiding, I would come.

examples.sentence: यह सामान कहाँ भेजा जा रहा है?
examples.translation: Where is this luggage being sent?

entries.intro: Relative adverb or conjunction of time. Used to introduce a time clause, usually paired with correlative 'तब' (#78).
entries.usage: Equivalent to relative 'when' (e.g. 'When X happens, then Y...').

examples.sentence: जब बारिश होगी, तब हम बाहर जाएँगे।
examples.translation: When it rains, then we will go outside.

examples.sentence: जब मैं छोटा था, तब गाँव में रहता था।
examples.translation: When I was young, I lived in the village.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं जानता कि तुम जब आओगे, तो मैं घर पर रुकता।
examples.translation: If I knew when you would come, I would stay at home.

examples.sentence: जब काम पूरा होता है, तब वेतन दिया जाता है।
examples.translation: When work is completed, then salary is given.

entries.intro: Correlative adverb of time. Used in pair with 'जब' (#77) or 'अगर' (#91).
entries.usage: Equivalent to correlative 'then' (e.g. 'When... then...').

examples.sentence: जब घंटी बजी, तब छात्र बाहर आए।
examples.translation: When the bell rang, then the students came out.

examples.sentence: मैं तब बहुत व्यस्त था।
examples.translation: I was very busy at that time.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम तब आते, तो हम बात करते।
examples.translation: If you had come then, we would talk.

examples.sentence: तब सभी फसलों को काट लिया जाता है।
examples.translation: Then all crops are harvested.

entries.intro: Interrogative pronoun used for asking about people.
entries.usage: Oblique form is 'किस' (singular) and 'किन' (plural). Takes verb agreement based on subject.

examples.sentence: वहाँ कौन है?
examples.translation: Who is there?

examples.sentence: यह काम कौन करेगा?
examples.translation: Who will do this work?

examples.sentence: यदि मैं जानता कि विजेता कौन है, तो बधाई देता।
examples.translation: If I knew who the winner is, I would congratulate.

examples.sentence: यह पुरस्कार किसके द्वारा जीता जाता है?
examples.translation: By whom is this award won? ('किस' is oblique of कौन)

entries.translation: him / her / to him / to her
entries.intro: The dative/accusative pronoun form of 'वह' (#12). Equivalent to 'him/her' or 'to him/her'. Cross-referenced with 'मुझे' (#81) and 'उन्हें' (#83).
entries.usage: Formed by वह + को. Used as direct object or indirect object.

examples.sentence: उसे बुलाओ।
examples.translation: Call him/her.

examples.sentence: मैंने उसे एक पत्र दिया।
examples.translation: I gave him/her a letter.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं उसे जानता, तो घर आमंत्रित करता।
examples.translation: If I knew him/her, I would invite to the house.

examples.sentence: उसे कल पुरस्कार दिया जाएगा।
examples.translation: He/She will be given an award tomorrow.

entries.intro: The dative/accusative pronoun form of first-person singular 'मैं' (#27). Cross-referenced with 'उसे' (#80) and 'तुम्हें' (#82).
entries.usage: Formed by मैं + को. Used as subject for psychological verbs (e.g. मुझे पसंद है - I like).

examples.sentence: मुझे सेब पसंद है।
examples.translation: I like apples.

examples.sentence: उसने मुझे अपनी कार दिखाई।
examples.translation: He showed me his car.

examples.sentence: यदि मुझे समय मिले, तो मैं घूमने जाऊँगा।
examples.translation: If I get time, I will go for a trip.

examples.sentence: मुझे एक नया काम सौंपा गया है।
examples.translation: I have been assigned a new task.

entries.intro: The dative/accusative pronoun form of second-person informal 'तुम' (#25). Cross-referenced with formal 'आपको'.
entries.usage: Formed by तुम + को.

examples.sentence: तुम्हें वहाँ जाना चाहिए।
examples.translation: You should go there.

examples.sentence: मैंने तुम्हें बाज़ार में देखा था।
examples.translation: I saw you in the market.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम्हें मदद चाहिए होती, तो तुम मुझे बताते।
examples.translation: If you wanted help, you would tell me.

examples.sentence: तुम्हें सूचित किया जाता है।
examples.translation: You are being informed.

entries.intro: The dative/accusative pronoun form of third-person plural 'वे' (#24). Used for plural persons or singular respectful reference. Cross-referenced with 'उसे' (#80).
entries.usage: Formed by वे + को. Pronounced 'unhein'.

examples.sentence: उन्हें काम करने दो।
examples.translation: Let them work.

examples.sentence: मैंने उन्हें अपनी समस्या बताई।
examples.translation: I told them/him my problem.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं उन्हें जानता, तो आदर करता।
examples.translation: If I knew them, I would show respect.

examples.sentence: उन्हें कल यहाँ बुलाया गया था।
examples.translation: They were called here yesterday.

entries.intro: Possessive pronoun/adjective derived from 'हम' (#23). Cross-referenced with 'तुम्हारा' (#85) and 'मेरा' (#87).
entries.usage: Inflects: हमारा (masculine singular), हमारे (masculine oblique/plural), हमारी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह हमारा नया स्कूल है।
examples.translation: This is our new school.

examples.sentence: हमारी बहन डॉक्टर है।
examples.translation: Our sister is a doctor. ('हमारी' agrees with feminine 'बहन')

examples.sentence: यदि हमारा घर बड़ा होता, तो हम सब साथ रहते।
examples.translation: If our house were bigger, we would all live together.

examples.sentence: हमारे नियमों का पालन किया जाता है।
examples.translation: Our rules are being followed.

entries.intro: Possessive pronoun/adjective derived from informal 'तुम' (#25). Cross-referenced with formal 'आपका' and 'हमारा' (#84).
entries.usage: Inflects: तुम्हारा (masculine), तुम्हारे (masculine oblique/plural), तुम्हारी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह तुम्हारा कुत्ता है।
examples.translation: This is your dog.

examples.sentence: तुम्हारी आँखें बहुत सुंदर हैं।
examples.translation: Your eyes are very beautiful.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम्हारा दोस्त यहाँ आता, तो हम खेलते।
examples.translation: If your friend came here, we would play.

examples.sentence: तुम्हारा नाम सूची में लिखा गया है।
examples.translation: Your name has been written in the list.

entries.intro: Possessive pronoun/adjective derived from third-person plural 'वे' (#24). Cross-referenced with singular 'उसका'.
entries.usage: Inflects: उनका (masculine), उनके (masculine oblique/plural), उनकी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह उनका नया मकान है।
examples.translation: This is their new house.

examples.sentence: उनकी माँ कल बाज़ार गईं।
examples.translation: Their/His mother went to the market yesterday.

examples.sentence: यदि उनके नियम सरल होते, तो अच्छा होता।
examples.translation: If their rules were simple, it would be good.

examples.sentence: उनका सामान सुरक्षित पहुँचाया गया।
examples.translation: Their luggage was delivered safely.

entries.intro: Possessive pronoun/adjective derived from first-person singular 'मैं' (#27). Cross-referenced with 'हमारा' (#84).
entries.usage: Inflects: मेरा (masculine), मेरे (masculine oblique/plural), मेरी (feminine).

examples.sentence: यह मेरा कमरा है।
examples.translation: This is my room.

examples.sentence: मेरी माँ एक शिक्षिका हैं।
examples.translation: My mother is a teacher.

examples.sentence: यदि मेरा दोस्त आता, तो मैं खुश होता।
examples.translation: If my friend came, I would be happy.

examples.sentence: मेरा नाम सूची से हटा दिया गया है।
examples.translation: My name has been removed from the list.

entries.intro: A reflexive possessive pronoun referring back to the grammatical subject of the sentence, regardless of gender or number.
entries.usage: Inflects like standard adjectives: अपना, अपने, अपनी. Equivalent to 'my own', 'his own', 'their own' depending on the subject.

examples.sentence: मैं अपना काम करता हूँ।
examples.translation: I do my own work.

examples.sentence: वह अपने घर जा रहा है।
examples.translation: He is going to his own house. ('अपने' agrees with masculine singular oblique)

examples.sentence: यदि तुम अपनी किताब लाते, तो मैं पढ़ता।
examples.translation: If you brought your own book, I would read.

examples.sentence: यह फैसला अपने लोगों द्वारा किया गया है।
examples.translation: This decision was taken by our own people.

entries.intro: A common coordinating conjunction expressing contrast or exception. Cross-referenced with synonym 'पर' (#13) and 'या' (#90).
entries.usage: Connects two opposing clauses.

examples.sentence: वह अमीर है लेकिन खुश नहीं है।
examples.translation: He is rich, but not happy.

examples.sentence: मैंने कोशिश की, लेकिन सफल नहीं हुआ।
examples.translation: I tried, but didn't succeed.

examples.sentence: यदि वह आती लेकिन बात न करती, तो मुझे बुरा लगता।
examples.translation: If she came but did not talk, I would feel bad.

examples.sentence: यह फैसला कठिन था लेकिन आखिरकार लिया गया।
examples.translation: This decision was difficult, but was eventually taken.

entries.intro: A coordinating conjunction representing an alternative.
entries.usage: Invariable. Paired as 'या तो... या...' (either... or...).

examples.sentence: तुम चाय लोगे या कॉफी?
examples.translation: Will you have tea or coffee?

examples.sentence: आज धूप होगी या बारिश।
examples.translation: Today will be sunny or rainy.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम या तुम्हारा दोस्त आता, तो बात बन जाती।
examples.translation: If you or your friend came, the matter would be resolved.

examples.sentence: यह काम राम या मोहन द्वारा किया जाएगा।
examples.translation: This work will be done by Ram or Mohan.

entries.intro: A subordinating conjunction of condition. Cross-referenced with synonym 'यदि' and the correlative clause marker 'तो' (#16).
entries.usage: Usually begins a conditional clause. Followed by 'तो' (then) in the main clause.

examples.sentence: अगर तुम आओगे, तो मैं चलूँगा।
examples.translation: If you come, then I will go.

examples.sentence: अगर बारिश होगी, तो खेल बंद हो जाएगा।
examples.translation: If it rains, then the game will stop.

examples.sentence: अगर मैं प्रधानमंत्री होता, तो गरीबी हटाता।
examples.translation: If I were the prime minister, I would remove poverty.

examples.sentence: अगर नियम तोड़ा जाता है, तो सजा दी जाती है।
examples.translation: If the rule is broken, then punishment is given.

entries.intro: A subordinating conjunction introducing a clause of reason or cause.
entries.usage: Pronounced 'kyonki'. Starts the explanatory clause.

examples.sentence: मैं स्कूल नहीं आया क्योंकि मैं बीमार था।
examples.translation: I didn't come to school because I was sick.

examples.sentence: वह खुश है क्योंकि उसने परीक्षा पास कर ली।
examples.translation: He is happy because he passed the exam.

examples.sentence: यदि वह रोता क्योंकि उसे चोट लगी होती, तो मैं मदद करता।
examples.translation: If he cried because he got hurt, I would help.

examples.sentence: यह काम रोका गया क्योंकि धन की कमी थी।
examples.translation: This work was stopped because there was a lack of funds.

entries.intro: Indicates association, accompaniment, or partnership. Often functions as compound postposition 'के साथ'.
entries.usage: As postposition, requires preceding 'के'. As adverb, means 'together'.

examples.sentence: वह मेरे साथ बाज़ार गया।
examples.translation: He went to the market with me.

examples.sentence: हम सब साथ रहते हैं।
examples.translation: We all live together.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम मेरे साथ चलते, तो अच्छा होता।
examples.translation: If you had come along with me, it would be good.

examples.sentence: यह पत्र दस्तावेजों के साथ भेजा जाता है।
examples.translation: This letter is sent along with the documents.

entries.intro: A compound postposition meaning 'about', 'concerning', or 'regarding'. Built on genitive 'के' (#8) + 'बारे में'.
entries.usage: Requires preceding 'के': 'मेरे बारे में' (about me), 'इस बारे में' (about this).

examples.sentence: वह मेरे बारे में बात कर रहा था।
examples.translation: He was talking about me.

examples.sentence: मुझे इस बारे में सब पता है।
examples.translation: I know everything about this.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम अपने बारे में सोचते, तो अच्छा होता।
examples.translation: If you thought about yourself, it would be good.

examples.sentence: कल बैठक में इस बारे में चर्चा की जाएगी।
examples.translation: This will be discussed in the meeting tomorrow.

entries.intro: Can mean physical closeness (near) or serve as a possession marker (equivalent to 'to have' in English, as in 'के पास होना').
entries.usage: Usually requires preceding 'के': 'मेरे पास एक पेन है' (I have a pen / near me is a pen).

examples.sentence: मेरा घर मंदिर के पास है।
examples.translation: My house is near the temple.

examples.sentence: रवि के पास बहुत पैसे हैं।
examples.translation: Ravi has a lot of money. (Possession)

examples.sentence: यदि तुम्हारे पास कार होती, तो हम चलते।
examples.translation: If you had a car, we would go.

examples.sentence: यह डाक घर के पास पहुँचाया जाता है।
examples.translation: This mail is delivered near the house.

entries.intro: Indicates a lower position, direction downwards, or being underneath. Cross-referenced with 'ऊपर' (#97).
entries.usage: Requires 'के' when used as postposition (e.g. 'पेड़ के नीचे' - under the tree).

examples.sentence: बिल्ली मेज के नीचे सो रही है।
examples.translation: The cat is sleeping under the table.

examples.sentence: वह नीचे उतर गया।
examples.translation: He went down.

examples.sentence: यदि तापमान नीचे गिरता, तो बर्फ पड़ती।
examples.translation: If the temperature dropped down, it would snow.

examples.sentence: कार को पुल के नीचे खड़ा किया जाता है।
examples.translation: The car is parked under the bridge.

entries.intro: Indicates a higher position, direction upwards, or being on top. Cross-referenced with 'नीचे' (#96).
entries.usage: Requires 'के' when used as postposition (e.g. 'छत के ऊपर' - on top of the roof).

examples.sentence: किताब अलमारी के ऊपर रखी है।
examples.translation: The book is placed on top of the cupboard.

examples.sentence: चिड़िया ऊपर उड़ गई।
examples.translation: The bird flew up.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं ऊपर आसमान में उड़ पाता, तो मज़ा आता।
examples.translation: If I could fly up in the sky, it would be fun.

examples.sentence: सामान को गाड़ी के ऊपर रखा जाता है।
examples.translation: The luggage is placed on top of the car.

entries.intro: Indicates the exterior or moving out of an enclosed space. Cross-referenced with 'अंदर' (#99).
entries.usage: Requires 'के' when acting as postposition (e.g. 'घर के बाहर' - outside the house).

examples.sentence: वह घर के बाहर खड़ा है।
examples.translation: He is standing outside the house.

examples.sentence: बच्चों, बाहर जाओ और खेलो।
examples.translation: Children, go outside and play.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम बाहर जाते, तो ताज़ी हवा मिलती।
examples.translation: If you went outside, you would get fresh air.

examples.sentence: कचरे को बाहर फेंका जाता है।
examples.translation: Garbage is thrown outside.

entries.intro: Indicates the interior or moving into an enclosed space. Cross-referenced with 'बाहर' (#98).
entries.usage: Requires 'के' when acting as postposition (e.g. 'कमरे के अंदर' - inside the room).

examples.sentence: चोर कमरे के अंदर घुस गया।
examples.translation: The thief entered inside the room.

examples.sentence: अंदर आओ और बैठो।
examples.translation: Come inside and sit down.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम अंदर आते, तो भीगने से बच जाते।
examples.translation: If you came inside, you would avoid getting wet.

examples.sentence: दूध को फ्रिज के अंदर रखा जाता है।
examples.translation: Milk is kept inside the fridge.

entries.intro: A unique word meaning either 'tomorrow' or 'yesterday' depending on the tense of the verb. Can also mean a machine or part of a machine ('कल-पुर्ज़े').
entries.usage: Invariable. Context/verb tense determines past or future reference.

examples.sentence: कल मैं स्कूल जाऊँगा।
examples.translation: Tomorrow I will go to school. (Future verb: जाऊँगा)

examples.sentence: कल मैं बीमार था।
examples.translation: Yesterday I was sick. (Past verb: था)

examples.sentence: यदि कल छुट्टी होती, तो हम बाहर घूमने जाते।
examples.translation: If yesterday/tomorrow were a holiday, we would go for an outing.

examples.sentence: यह कारखाना कल बंद रखा जाएगा।
examples.translation: This factory will be kept closed tomorrow.

entries.intro: Companion entry: the infinitive verb behind the capacity modal 'सकता' (#39). Expresses capability, potential, or permission.
entries.usage: Intransitive modal verb. Always conjugates in conjunction with the root form of another main verb (e.g. खा सकना - to be able to eat).

examples.sentence: मैं तैर सकना चाहता हूँ।
examples.translation: I want to be able to swim.

examples.sentence: वह बिना चश्मे के पढ़ सकता है।
examples.translation: He is able to read without glasses.

examples.sentence: यदि मैं समय पर पहुँच सकता, तो बहुत अच्छा होता.
examples.translation: If I could be able to reach on time, it would be very good.

examples.sentence: यह भारी संदूक राम से उठाया जा सकता है।
examples.translation: This heavy chest can be lifted by Ram.

entries.intro: Companion entry: the infinitive verb behind the obligation/desire form 'चाहिए' (#40). To want, desire, or love.
entries.usage: Transitive regular verb: चाहना, चाहा, चाहेगा. Root for 'चाहिए' (which represents 'should / is needed').

examples.sentence: मैं चाय पीना चाहता हूँ।
examples.translation: I want to drink tea.

examples.sentence: वह सफलता चाहता है।
examples.translation: He wants success.

examples.sentence: यदि तुम मेरी मदद करना चाहते, तो ज़रूर करते।
examples.translation: If you wanted to help me, you would surely do so.

examples.sentence: सबके द्वारा शांति चाही जाती है।
examples.translation: Peace is desired by all.
